$comment: Accepted module tangles per home, seeded from the state at the check's introduction. A home is the longest module path every member of a tangle shares; the list is the sizes of the tangles living there, largest first, counted AFTER parent-child hubs collapse (so splitting a file into submodules adds nothing here). A strict ratchet: local runs lower a list to what's measured and drop a home that comes clean, and raising one needs David's OK (.claude/rules/file-length-allowlist.md). The fix for a home over its numbers is to cut an edge, not to bump the number. `toolVersion` is the cargo-modules release these numbers came from; the check refuses to compare against a different one.
